posts.name: Heckbringer
posts.cooked:
grim88:

For sure one of the Bunker promos (and probably the newer as well) and Unity are differant entities.

 

I had a look, and here are my thoughts…

Absolute Zero may or may not be the same entity. The promo one looks to me to be much larger and more muscular, so I'm thinking they're two different entities.

Bunker looks to be two different entities, since I'm pretty sure the original is caucasian, and the promo one is decidedly not.

Fanatic I'm not sure about… It could be the lighting, but it's looking like there are two different skin tones and therefore two different characters.

Haka I'm also not sure about… It could be the same character, but there seems to be an enormous difference in style between them.

Legacy is obviously two different beings.

Tachyon looks to be the same character with different hairstyles and outfits. I think it's the same person.

Tempest looks to be the same being, one card looks to be at a later time after at least one difficult encounter…

Unity I could go either way on… It's possible the golems made the promo card version, or it seems plausible she did that to herself and the promo is the same character from a later time.

Wraith looks like it's probably the same character from different times in her life.

Visionary looks like it's two different characters, but it's plausible that it's the same character in two different time streams or maybe the same character after undergoing some intense hardship.

It looks to me like all the new promos are the same characters as the originals, with perhaps a different focus or at a different time.

Thoughts on any of that? I didn't miss anyone did I?

"Officially", it's just one deck for each hero - the game isn't really meant to be played with multiples of a single hero's deck.

posts.name: jagarciao
posts.cooked:
I have a deck available for each hero and their promo version and have used them together with varying degrees of success using a variety of house rules. 

Free-flowing beer and fun-loving friends certainly increase the chances of success/fun. 

 

P.S. I have mentioned this before, but I'll reiterate: if you are going to use multiple decks of the same hero in one game I recommend you mark the cards for one deck or sleeve them differently or somehow differentiate them in some way (I put a small blue dot on the corner of one deck). Otherwise you might spend a lot of time separating the decks if you mix them/drop them accidentally.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
It has been said that there is only one Legacy at a time, and that makes sense, because there is only one ring, and the bearer is Legacy.

So for multiple Bunkers, or Legacies or whatever to happen you would need time shiftiness.

If you have time shiftiness, which the most recent expansion was sort of all about, then any freedom 6 promos could easily repeat, Tachyon and TL Tachyon teaming up to save their friend from himself (or at least trying),

For others, Wraith going back in time to stop RC Wraith from making a terrible mistake, or to stop a villain from going back and killing her or something.  Eternal Haka somehow getting his younger self, and trying to fix some terrible wrong that would change history.

 

I know Pauline goes out with her dad and the team, but she wouldn't be leading them, and a good chunk of the deck reflects the leadership aspect of Legacy.  With timelines converging it would make sense to use that deck, since you could get each Legacy when they were Legacy.

I'd want a modified deck to reflect Pauline before she inherited the ring, one that was less leadership and less dominant, maybe more focused on damage or having a minor role on the team.

I just couldn't put the Legacy deck out there for Pauline while her dad was still in charge.
